title: 中国人怎么吃一条鱼③水煮鱼：名叫"水煮"，端上桌却是一整盆红油 | How China Eats a Fish P3 · Sichuan Boiled Fish in Chili Oil 🔥
description:
你吃辣能到第几级？这盆红油你扛得住吗？

《中国人怎么吃一条鱼》第三集：川渝水煮鱼。名字最有反差——叫"水煮"，端上来却是一整盆滚烫红油。其实关键真在"水"：鱼片先在滚水里飞快一氽，锁住嫩度，一夹就颤；碗底垫一层豆芽，鱼片码上，再堆满干辣椒和花椒，最后浇一勺滚油，"刺啦"一声，麻辣香气瞬间炸开。水煮鱼起源于重庆渝北翠云乡，从纤夫、司机的粗放江湖菜起家，借鉴了川菜"水煮牛肉"的路子；1983年在厨艺大赛上拿奖走红，1985年前后基本定型。四川人尝到这口麻辣鲜香，会由衷说一句「巴适」。

How China eats a fish, Part 3: Sichuan-Chongqing boiled fish. The name is the trick — "boiled fish" arrives as a whole basin of scarlet chili oil. But water really is the secret: the slices are flash-poached just long enough to stay silky and quivering, laid over a bed of bean sprouts, then buried under dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns before a ladle of smoking oil hits with a loud sizzle and the aroma explodes. It was born in Cuiyun, Chongqing, out of the rough riverside cooking of boatmen and truck drivers — modeled on classic "water-boiled beef" — won a cooking contest in 1983 and settled into its modern form by 1985. That numbing, fragrant heat is what Sichuanese call "báshì" — just right.

下集·完结：重庆酸菜鱼——一把酸菜，居然比鱼还出名。
